description: This Java source file defines a final class `ImmutableFeatureFromScratchBuilder` that implements multiple builder interfaces (`FeatureBuilder`, `FeatureBuilder.FromJsonBuildable`, `FeatureBuilder.FromScratchBuildable`, `FeatureBuilder.FeatureBuildable`) for constructing `Feature` objects. It provides methods to create builder instances from JSON objects or from scratch, set feature properties such as ID, definition, and properties, and eventually build a `Feature` object. It uses annotations for thread safety and nullability, and references external classes like `JsonObject`, `ConditionChecker`, and `ThingsModelFactory`. The class facilitates the fluent builder pattern for creating feature instances in the project.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromScratchBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, fluent builder class for creating `Feature` instances with support for building from JSON or from scratch, allowing setting of feature ID, definition, and properties.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the final `Feature` object based on internal state, returning a null feature if JSON null was set.
